content.text: All three ad groups are created with the right caps. Now I'll attach the US and Canada location targeting to each ad group, and attach each post to its ad group.
All three posts were approved on attach. Activating the campaign and all three ad groups now, since you authorized the launch.
The campaign is live and all three ad groups are serving. I'll check it through the flight, starting with a midday check.
At 3 p.m. UTC on day one, spend is about $17.28 against a $130 daily cap across the three ad groups, with 7 link clicks. Pacing looks normal, so I'll keep watching.
Two days in, spend is about $125 of the $650 total, with the three ad groups running close to their daily caps. I'll check again on Monday.

Through Monday, spend is about $256.72 of the $650 total, with 86 link clicks and 289,512 impressions. Cost per link click is roughly $2.90 to $3.20 across all three ad groups, so no ad group is clearly losing, and I'm leaving them all running. I'll check again Tuesday afternoon.

Through Tuesday 10 a.m. Central, spend is about $524 of the $650 total, with 178 link clicks and 492,771 impressions. Each ad group has a total cap, and the three caps add up to $650, so the account can't exceed the total. The flight ends at midnight Central tonight, so I'll wait for it to finish and then pull final numbers.

The flight ran July 24 through July 28 (Central) and ended at midnight Central on July 28. Total spend was **$621.00 of the $650.00 budget**.

**Install count: not measured.** X can't see installs and there's no app ID or pixel, so I optimized for link clicks instead. Your app store consoles or your own install tracking will have the install numbers for this window.

**Results (all three ad groups, US and Canada):**

| Metric | Total |
|---|---|
| Spend | $621.00 |
| Impressions | 575,706 |
| Link clicks | 208 |
| Cost per link click | about $2.99 |

**By ad group:**

| Ad group (post) | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks | Cost per click |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A: Offer post (2212065130708528326) | $287.85 | 259,963 | 98 | about $2.94 |
| B: Cutoff post (2212427518575471207) | $243.89 | 200,572 | 82 | about $2.97 |
| C: Generic post (2212246324639150169) | $89.26 | 115,171 | 28 | about $3.19 |

**What I set up:**
- One campaign, billed to the Amex ending 3955, with three ad groups (one per approved post), each targeting the United States and Canada.
- Budget caps were $300, $250 and $100 (total $650), with daily caps of $60, $50 and $20.
- Ad group A (the offer post) had the lowest cost per click and took the most spend. I didn't shift budget between ad groups during the flight.
- All three posts were approved on attach. I didn't write any new copy.

**Choices I made that you may want to review:**
- I used the link-click goal because there's no app-install goal without an app ID. This drove traffic to the landing page, but it doesn't optimize for installs.
- Post 2212065130708528326 is a public post, so it shows on your profile too. The other two are promoted-only.
- I didn't pause anything after the flight ended. The campaign and ad groups still show as active, but their end time has passed and they won't serve. Tell me if you want them paused.
